Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an unidentified '[[LEP servant droid/Legends|''LEP servant droid''']] was used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to lure [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] into the back room of a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Trueping's/Legends|cantina]] to be captured.
